items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Oh yeah. I know he's good. I know he's good. I know he's good. Louis come from the home. From Jones home.

ctx.x: Well, Louis Armstrong used to be good too. He was a good blues player. Do you really think he's good?
Oh yeah. I know he's good. I know he's good. I know he's good. Louis come from the home. From Jones home. Many of them did.
Yeah. Jones is throwing a lot of good trumpet players out there now.
